title: refactor(driver-sql): move the declared column DEFAULT emission out of sql-driver.ts into sql-driver-schema-sync.ts (#25521 cut 19)

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XCTPWahtfVNDqaZ7ZjxvNs5)_

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:把 `sql-driver.ts` 里「字段默认值在建表语句里写成什么」这一个机制的两个方法体(`nowColumnDefault`:`defaultValue: 'NOW()'` 在各数据库方言下的列默认值;`applyDeclaredColumnDefault`:判断一个字段的 `defaultValue` 该不该、以什么形式成为列默认值)原样搬进已有的 `sql-driver-schema-sync.ts`;类上两个方法全部保留,只把方法体转交过去,`SchemaSyncHost` 一个成员都不用加。
- **为什么改**:#25521 拆分超大文件的第 19 刀;第 18 刀合入后重新测量,这是仍成「一个机制」、收益最大且不碰任何系列限制的区域,`sql-driver.ts` 减少 41 行。
- **风险与回滚**:纯搬移,无行为变化;三个 SQL 驱动的测试两端逐条一致,公开类型声明哈希不变,149 条探针读数两端一致(仅 1 条栈顶接收者名不同)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`sql-driver-schema-sync.ts` 头注释新增的第 19 刀段落与文件末尾两个函数;`sql-driver.ts` 中两个方法的转交桩;`sql-driver.ts` 里 `MYSQL_DATETIME_PRECISION`、`isNowDefaultValue` 两处就地加 `export`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run src/sql-driver-user-datetime-default-format.test.ts src/sql-driver-option-default-ddl.test.ts src/sql-driver-21241-mysql-now-default-precision.test.ts src/sql-driver-11550-dialect-client-spellings.test.ts`,预期全部通过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Cut 19 of the `sql-driver.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). The claim is `6454724955`. Cut 18 (#26894) merged first, as `452325eed9`; this cut opens with a fresh seam table taken on `origin/main` `4049efa345` (below) and takes the largest area that is one mechanism and moves cleanly: the **declared column DEFAULT emission**, from the class's `Internal helpers › Column creation helper` sub-banner. Its two bodies move unedited into the **existing** seam module `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-schema-sync.ts`, through its host `SchemaSyncHost`:

- `nowColumnDefault`, the driver-native column DEFAULT for a `defaultValue: 'NOW()'` field, per dialect and per `date` / `time` / `datetime` type (the UTC expression defaults of #3994 and #4022, the MySQL `DATETIME(3)` precision of #21241, the canonical SQLite `strftime` forms);
- `applyDeclaredColumnDefault`, the one place that decides what a field's `defaultValue` becomes in DDL (`NOW()` through `nowColumnDefault`; a runtime token such as `current_user` emits nothing, #4560; an expression envelope emits nothing; a literal is emitted verbatim).

The SQLite table rebuild that cut 6 moved into this module (`rebuildSqliteTablePatched`) already reaches both through `SchemaSyncHost`, which already lists both members and every member their bodies read, so **the host does not grow**. `createColumn` (pinned in place) and `createAuditTimestampColumn`, the other callers, stay in the class and still call the two methods on the driver.

**Module-level declarations.** None moves. The bodies read three:

- `MYSQL_DATETIME_PRECISION` and `isNowDefaultValue` are declared in `sql-driver.ts`, which still reads both (`createAuditTimestampColumn`, `createColumn`, the MySQL widenings). Each gains `export` in place, and the module imports them from `./sql-driver.js` through its existing import line. `index.ts` names its re-exports one by one and names neither, so the published surface does not move (measured below).
- `isRuntimeDefaultToken` comes from `@objectstack/spec/data`. Its only reader in `sql-driver.ts` moved, so it leaves that import line (`isNowDefaultToken` stays there), and the module adds it to its existing `@objectstack/spec/data` import.
- The moved signatures name `Knex.Raw` and `Knex.ColumnBuilder`, so the module gains `import type { Knex } from 'knex';` (erased; `sql-driver-autonumber.ts` has the same line).

The change is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts. There is no `docs/adr/**` edit, no `packages/spec/**` edit, no anchor entry change, no gate edit, no test edit and no new gate. Branch `claude/project-thread-1nvx81` (the platform assigned it to this card thread, as the claim records). The move is one commit, `fe7fb7ec5`, on `4049efa345`, followed by one merge of `origin/main` (`aa00362fe5`, 12 commits, none in `packages/drivers/**`); the head is `79ca88b71b`.

**Net line count (the seat's rule).** `sql-driver.ts` goes from 18,447 lines to 18,406: **-41**.

- **Out:** the two bodies, 60 lines plus their closing braces (51 + 9).
- **In:** the two stub bodies, 19 lines with their closing braces (13 + 6), and 2 comment lines above the existing `sql-driver-schema-sync.js` import, whose one line gains the two names. The `@objectstack/spec/data` token import and the two `export` additions change lines in place.
- `sql-driver-schema-sync.ts` goes from 2,066 to 2,148 lines (+82): the two functions with their one-line docblocks, a 13-line header paragraph and the `knex` type import. `SchemaSyncHost` is unchanged (80 members).

**Path readers.** No test, script, doc, ADR or anchor entry reads either body by path, so none is migrated (screen below).

**Serial with the file's in-flight PRs.** I read the file list of every open PR on `objectstack-ai/objectstack` at the start (39) and again before opening this one (30). None touches `sql-driver.ts`, `sql-driver-schema-sync.ts`, `turso-driver.ts`, `sqlite-wasm-driver.ts`, `check-tenant-chokepoint.mjs` or a driver-sql anchor entry; #26556 (dependabot) touches only the three drivers' `package.json`.

### Pricing the areas

Eligibility is as cuts 11-18 defined it: an annotated return type or not public; no `getBuilder`, `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(`, private-static, `super`, bare-`this` or `this`-write site; not `insertOnlyUpsertColumns`; not a member pinned in place (`createColumn`, `applyFilterCondition`, `formatInput`/`formatOutput`, `initObjects`, `ensureShardTable`, `computeTenantField`, `migrateMysqlDatetimeColumns`/`migrateMysqlTimeColumns`, `compileFilters`). Each area is priced as its stubs minus its bodies, then net of the module-level declarations only it reads and of its import edits. The two leading rows were measured by running the move script on a scratch copy of the base file; the rest are the stub estimate (a stub costs 4 lines, +2 per field read, +1 per method read).

Cut 18 priced the largest clean single area at about -62, naming two candidates: the class head's date-bucket/query-timing pair and the column-creation remainder. Re-measured, neither is one mechanism: each -62 is the sum of a sub-banner's movable members, the same kind of sum as the filter-helper remainder this series does not stitch. So I priced mechanism by mechanism.

## Why

### Why this area, as one area

- **One mechanism.** The two answer one question, "what does a field's declared `defaultValue` become in the DDL of a fresh or rebuilt column", and `applyDeclaredColumnDefault` is how a declared field's `NOW()` reaches `nowColumnDefault`. They go beside the SQLite rebuild that already calls both through the host. The other callers of `nowColumnDefault` (the audit-column DDL, the MySQL datetime widening, the rebuild's audit columns) still call the method on the driver.
- **It pays the most of any single mechanism that moves cleanly.** Date bucketing (-42 in bodies) is within one line of it in bodies, but needs a new module and its import line; this area joins a module whose import line and host already exist.
- **What stays, and why.** `createAuditTimestampColumn` (its stub would cost more than its body) and the rest of the `Column creation helper` sub-banner: the hash-shadow and varchar-width members read private statics, `createColumn` is pinned, and the row-size and hash-shadow explanations are other mechanisms.
- **No series limit is touched.** Neither body builds through `getBuilder`, reads a static, has a `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` site, uses `super` or a bare `this`, or assigns to `this`. Both are protected with annotated returns (`Knex.Raw`, `void`). `check:tenant-chokepoint`'s D8 predicates, measured with its own `nullArmsOf`: **4 at base and 4 at head**, all in `sql-driver.ts`, 0 in the moved bodies.
- **Durability gate.** Neither body has a `try` or calls `logDurabilityFailure`. `check:durability-log-level --list` prints 164 lines at both ends, identical except that two `runWideningAlters` seams in `sql-driver.ts` move 2 lines down (the import comment).
- **Subclasses.** `TursoDriver` and `SqliteWasmDriver` override neither method; `remote-transport.ts` names `applyDeclaredColumnDefault` in prose, which is still true. Tests that widen the class (the CLI's `generate-declared-column-default.pin.test.ts` oracle and four driver-sql suites) call `this.nowColumnDefault(type)` on a subclass instance, which still reaches the same body.
- **Path readers, screened.** No script, test, doc or ADR names either member by a `sql-driver.ts#…` pointer or a `sql-driver.ts::…` key, and no `scripts/adr-anchors/**` record names them. ADR-0053 names `nowColumnDefault` in prose, still true.

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1-18 apply it)

- Each class method keeps its docblock and signature, byte-identical. Its body is now one host literal plus `NAME.call(host, ...)`, marked `[#25521 cut 19]`. Both methods are synchronous at both ends, so a failure is still a synchronous throw (probe reading 7).
- The fields `nowColumnDefault` reads (`isMysql`, `isPostgres`, `isSqlite`, `knex`) go as GETTERS that read the driver at call time. The method `applyDeclaredColumnDefault` calls (`nowColumnDefault`) goes as a closure that calls the method on the driver at call time. So a subclass override, an instance spy, or a field replaced after construction is still the one the body reaches (probe readings 2, 5, 6).
- **Comments.** The module header gains one `[#25521 cut 19]` paragraph saying what moved, what stayed and where each read declaration comes from. The `sql-driver.ts` import comment names cut 19 in 2 lines. Neither cites an `ADR-NNNN` letter. Both stubs keep their docblocks (which mention ADR-0074 and #4560/#7246) in `sql-driver.ts`.
- **How the move was made.** A script produced it from the source text; nothing was retyped. Each body line is re-indented two columns; no body line starts inside a template literal.

## Verification

### ADR anchors

- **The count.** `check:adr-anchors` counts **1897** decision-letter citations at base `4049efa345` (a clean detached worktree) and **1897** at the move commit, over 91 anchored files at both ends; the two outputs are byte-identical. Both runs exit 0.
- **Why equal.** No comment inside the moved bodies or the new header paragraph cites a decision letter.
- **No entry needs a new home.** No anchor entry names a moved member. `check:adr-symbol-anchors`: 2687 resolve at both ends (output byte-identical).
- **After the merge.** `main` moved under the cut, and its own commits changed the count, so I measured its tip `aa00362fe5` (a clean detached worktree) against the merge head `79ca88b71b`: **1896** letters at both, exit 0 both, and 2687 symbol anchors resolve at both.

### The published `.d.ts` does not change

This is measured under the series bar (ruling `6348891160`, item 1).

- **How each end was built.** `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/driver-sql --force` at each end, against the same dependency tree. The base leg writes base `sql-driver.ts` and base `sql-driver-schema-sync.ts` into this worktree under an EXIT/INT/TERM trap that restores HEAD. The restore is proved by the HEAD blob hashes, an empty `git diff HEAD` and 0 status entries (`RESTORE-OK 1084637988… 8b345d7a5c…`).
- **The hashes.** The raw sha256 of `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.mts` is the same at base, at the move commit and at the merge head: `0f33bf3febaac3c7aa96f68a4226d752766b8203ab7acade523b69f9aaa44d74` (unchanged since cut 8). These two are the dist's only declaration files (no chunk), so the declaration-reorder bar of ruling `6441032442` does not come into play.
- **Positive control.** I dropped `protected` from `nowColumnDefault` in a copy of the head `index.d.ts` (1 hit, then 0). The copy hashes to `ae5be4b2d6abbda6d50b0c513af286406f61d5d9e9a97a53c8da4d4d0a7b3359`, with `cmp` exit 1.
- **Export lists.** CJS `require` of each dist gives 59 names (sha1 `05757ce5ae` at both ends); the ESM namespace of `index.mjs` gives the same 59 at both ends (sha1 `05757ce5ae`). Neither moved function, neither newly exported declaration and not `SchemaSyncHost` is among them.
- **The head dist carries the move.** `.call(host` sites in `index.mjs` go from 67 at base to 69 at head (the two stubs).

### Move-only proof

The proof compares TypeScript compiler AST leaf tokens (JSDoc nodes skipped), base `4049efa345` against the move commit `fe7fb7ec5`. It is a scratch script and is not committed.

| Moved body | Body tokens | Comments | Parameter tokens less `this` | Return type tokens | Body lines |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `nowColumnDefault` | 172 | 31 | 3 | 3 | 51 |
| `applyDeclaredColumnDefault` | 71 | 0 | 11 | 1 | 9 |

- **Each moved body.** In both rows, 0 tokens differ and every comment is identical. Each body line is the base line less two leading spaces. Neither is `async` at either end.
- **The two stubs.** Leading trivia (the docblock), modifiers and the signature are identical to base.
- **The class.** It has 350 members at both ends, in the same order, and the 348 unmoved members are byte-identical, trivia included.
- **Top level of `sql-driver.ts`.** 175 of 180 base statements are byte-identical; the other five are the class, the two edited imports (the spec token import loses `isRuntimeDefaultToken`; the schema-sync import gains two names and its 2-line comment), and `MYSQL_DATETIME_PRECISION` and `isNowDefaultValue`, each checked to gain a leading `export` and nothing else.
- **The module.** Its 45 base statements are all in the head module byte-identical except three: its first import (whose leading trivia is the header, which gained the cut 19 paragraph), the `@objectstack/spec/data` import (`isRuntimeDefaultToken` added) and the `./sql-driver.js` import (`isNowDefaultValue` and `MYSQL_DATETIME_PRECISION` added). The head adds the `knex` type import and the two functions. `SchemaSyncHost` is byte-identical.
- **Result.** `PROOF OK`, exit 0; on the merge head its output is byte-identical.
- **Negative control.** Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, I changed `(cast(utc_timestamp() as date))` to `(cast(utc_timestamp() as datez))` in the module's `nowColumnDefault` (anchor 1 hit, then 0, checked on disk). The proof then reports `nowColumnDefault` as differing, prints `PROOF FAILED`, and exits 1. The restore was proved (blob `8b345d7a5c` equals HEAD, empty `git diff HEAD`).

### Tests

Each end ran under one `os-verify-lock` hold, after building that end's driver-sql dist. I compared the vitest JSON per test name and status, base `4049efa345` against the move commit `fe7fb7ec5`, and then the merge head `79ca88b71b` against the same base. Every part's exit code was captured on its own (build, probe, three suites: all 0 at every leg).

| Suite | Base | Head | Lost / changed / added |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `@objectstack/driver-sql` | 4061 (3847 passed, 214 skipped; 248 files) | same | 0 / 0 / 0 |
| `@objectstack/driver-turso`, against that end's built driver-sql dist | 2526 (2492 passed, 34 skipped; 95 files) | same | 0 / 0 / 0 |
| `@objectstack/driver-sqlite-wasm` | 746 (746 passed; 39 files) | same | 0 / 0 / 0 |

On the merge head (it brings in `main` up to `aa00362fe5`: 12 commits, none in `packages/drivers/**`), the three suites give the same totals and the same per-test statuses as base, 0 / 0 / 0 in each. Since then `main` has moved 11 more commits to `40264beec4`, none in `packages/drivers/**`; `git merge-tree --write-tree` of the head with it exits 0, so the tree is not stale.

- **Type check and lint.** `tsc --noEmit -p .` in driver-sql exits 0 on the move commit and on the merge head. `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/drivers/driver-sql` exits 0 (driver-sql has no `lint` script of its own).
- **Late-binding probe.** A scratch script, not committed. It runs node against each end's built dist and prints 149 readings, each with the result or the error's class, message and top stack frame:
  1. `nowColumnDefault` on SQLite, PostgreSQL and MySQL drivers (never connected) for `date`, `time`, `datetime` and two non-temporal types;
  2. a SUBCLASS overriding the `isSqlite` and `isPostgres` getters (the overrides are the ones read);
  3. `knex` replaced on the instance after construction, then restored;
  4. `applyDeclaredColumnDefault` on all three dialects over 13 `defaultValue` shapes (absent, `null`, two `NOW()` spellings and a bare `now`, `current_user` in two cases, an expression envelope, a string, `0`, `false`, a decimal, an array) for three types, with a recording column builder, and with no field at all;
  5. an instance spy on `nowColumnDefault` (it is the one `applyDeclaredColumnDefault` reaches);
  6. a subclass override of `nowColumnDefault` (likewise);
  7. a failure inside the body (`knex` unset): a synchronous `TypeError`;
  8. real SQLite DDL through `initObjects`: the stored column defaults (`PRAGMA table_info`) and a defaulted row's shapes for declared `NOW()` datetime/date/time fields, literals, `current_user`, `false`, an option-level `default`, and the audit columns;
  9. the SQLite rebuild path (`rebuildSqliteTablePatched`) after a re-`initObjects` that adds a literal default and a `NOW()` column;
  10. both methods' shape on the prototype (type, arity).
- **Probe result.** 148 of the 149 readings are identical. The other one is reading 7, which differs only in the top stack frame's receiver name: `_SqlDriver.nowColumnDefault` at base and `Object.nowColumnDefault` at head. That is shape B's receiver, the same at every earlier cut, and no test or consumer reads it. On the merge head the probe output is byte-identical to the move commit's.
- **Not run.** No ablation, because no tested behaviour changed.
- **`test:repo`.** Not run locally; it is CI's run on this PR.

### Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives **48** families for this diff, the same list on the move commit and on the merge head (and the same 48 cuts 17 and 18 derived). I ran each one on its own and captured its exit code before any pipe, after a full `pnpm build` of that tree (116 of 116 tasks).
